deskyard drag: left-drag from one point to another

Usage: deskyard [-e NAME] drag X1 Y1 X2 Y2

Presses the left button at X1 Y1, moves to X2 Y2 and releases it.

Arguments:
  X1         integer     required  start x
  Y1         integer     required  start y
  X2         integer     required  end x
  Y2         integer     required  end y

Prints: nothing

Examples:
  deskyard drag 100 100 400 300

Where: inside an environment it acts locally; elsewhere on the chosen environment (-e NAME)
Exit codes: 0 ok, 1 error, 2 usage error; otherwise the exit code of the action on the desktop
